story.vex: You can't fix everything at once. Pick wrong and I'll show you which one mattered. (Commander Vex, Planet Doom)
story.victory: DOOM ATTACK REPELLED, in advance: the top risks are already treated before Vex could use them. Astro: "Too many threats, too few hands. Now we know which ones go first."

files.C:\\Citadel\\README.txt:
ORDERS FROM ASTRO
=================
Too many threats, too few hands. Read risk-register.txt: five risks, each with a likelihood and impact. Decide, for each, whether the crew should treat it (fix it now), transfer it (get help/insurance), or accept it (live with it, it's minor).
files.C:\\Citadel\\risk-register.txt:
CITADEL RISK REGISTER
----------------------
risk-relay-password   likelihood: high    impact: high     (factory password still in use on a public door)
risk-cargo-bay-lock    likelihood: low     impact: low      (an old cargo bay lock, rarely used, nothing valuable inside)
risk-comms-single-path likelihood: medium  impact: high     (only one comms relay; if it drops, the crew is blind)
risk-snack-stock       likelihood: high    impact: low      (running low on rations, annoying but not dangerous)
risk-backup-offsite    likelihood: low     impact: high     (no offsite backup of the starmap; best handled by an ally crew)

Rule of thumb: high likelihood AND high impact -> treat it yourselves, now.
High impact but something an ally can help carry -> transfer it.
Low impact, whatever the likelihood -> accept it and move on.

steps.title: Rate and treat the register
steps.body: Astro: "Too many threats, too few hands. Sort them." Read `risk-register.txt`, then classify each risk: `classify risk-relay-password treat`, `classify risk-cargo-bay-lock accept`, and so on, using treat, transfer, or accept.

objectives.label: risk-backup-offsite: transfer (high impact, an ally can help)
